question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value
sql:
WITH max_compositions AS (
    SELECT 
        interest_id,
        MAX(composition) AS max_composition
    FROM interest_metrics
    GROUP BY interest_id
),
top_10 AS (
    SELECT 
        im2.interest_name,
        im.month_year AS time,
        im.composition
    FROM max_compositions max_vals
    JOIN interest_metrics im ON max_vals.interest_id = im.interest_id AND max_vals.max_composition = im.composition
    JOIN interest_map im2 ON im.interest_id = im2.id
    ORDER BY max_vals.max_composition DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
bottom_10 AS (
    SELECT 
        im2.interest_name,
        im.month_year AS time,
        im.composition
    FROM max_compositions max_vals
    JOIN interest_metrics im ON max_vals.interest_id = im.interest_id AND max_vals.max_composition = im.composition
    JOIN interest_map im2 ON im.interest_id = im2.id
    ORDER BY max_vals.max_composition ASC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT interest_name, time, composition FROM top_10
UNION ALL
SELECT interest_name, time, composition FROM bottom_10
ORDER BY composition DESC;

function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments:
{"sql": "
WITH max_compositions AS (
    SELECT 
        interest_id,
        MAX(composition) AS max_composition
    FROM interest_metrics
    GROUP BY interest_id
),
top_bottom AS (
    SELECT 
        im2.interest_name,
        im.month_year AS time,
        im.composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY max_vals.max_composition DESC) AS top_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY max_vals.max_composition ASC) AS bottom_rank
    FROM max_compositions max_vals
    JOIN interest_metrics im ON max_vals.interest_id = im.interest_id AND max_vals.max_composition = im.composition
    JOIN interest_map im2 ON im.interest_id = im2.id
)
SELECT interest_name, time, composition
FROM (
    SELECT interest_name, time, composition, top_rank
    FROM top_bottom
    WHERE top_rank <= 10
    UNION ALL
    SELECT interest_name, time, composition, bottom_rank
    FROM top_bottom
    WHERE bottom_rank <= 10
)
ORDER BY top_rank;
"}
